name: Term-Defined line derives PricingTermCount via Proration step
what_it_tests: A TermDefined line must derive its platform read-only PricingTermCount (and EndDate) via the Proration element; this writer was deleted in the V11->V12 rebuild leaving PTC null/unwritable across V12-V14, blocking convert/activation
proc_mechanism: ProrationTermDefined element (input EffectiveFrom/To/PricingTermUnit/ItemSubscriptionTerm, filter SellingModelType='TermDefined' AND StartProrationPeriod IsNotNull AND SubscriptionTerm IsNotNull) -> ProrationMultiplier -> PricingTermCount; ListOperationTermDefinedPTC
expected_behavior: Fresh reprice derives PricingTermCount=1 (or fractional) and EndDate automatically; both carry to OrderItem on convert; CalculationStatus=CompletedWithPricing
test_setup: TermDefined product (e.g. ACTIDB/BESTSU, annual, ServiceDate set, PeriodBoundary=Anniversary, SubscriptionTerm=12 Months), reprice

prior_run.actual: After 3 Force-reprices on V21, PricingTermCount stays NULL on two well-configured TermDefined lines: Cobalt Strike Qty5 (0QLWC000003kmBB4AY) and beSECURE Qty3 (0QLWC000003kmJF4AY), both SubTerm=1/PeriodBoundary=Anniversary/EndDate set. Org-wide TermDefined Draft lines modified today split 40 null vs 46 set (writer fires intermittently). EndDate present only because set at insert, not derived.
prior_run.defectStep: Proration (V21 steps 97/121/122/123: Term-Defined proration filter Line level + List Operation + Proration) — PricingTermCount write-back not persisting on fresh reprice
prior_run.notes: Active proc = Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 (9QBWC0000000oWH4AY). Reprice REST 'place' returned isSuccess=true all 3 times. Net price came out 0 on these lines (catalog list 5900/0) but I-01 asserts on PTC/EndDate, not net. Order-tier Fortra_OrderItem_Set_Dates V6 backstop masks this in UAT at convert; root quote-tier derivation still broken. Defect_provenance SC-3420/3411/3406/3415 = regression of the SC-3420 quote-tier PTC fix.
